responses.clear_failed: Failed to clear data for <@{user_id}> or no data existed.
responses.no_data_provided: You didn't tell me what to remember.
responses.clear_confirm: This will permanently erase everything I remember about you. Continue?
responses.clear_not_yours: This confirmation is not for you.

ask_others.prompt:
{target}, {asker} would like me to remember this about you: {memory}
Save it to your personal memory?
ask_others.sent: Asked them to accept; it is remembered only once they do.
ask_others.too_often: You have asked people to accept too often lately. Try again in {wait}s.
ask_others.unavailable: A memory about someone else can only be proposed to a member of this server.
ask_others.ask_not_yours: Only the member being asked can answer.
ask_others.ask_expired: No answer in time; nothing was remembered.
ask_others.ask_replaced: Replaced by a newer request; this one was not remembered.
